info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Vendor Registry Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Registers a vendor (a name and a category: no contact, no money), reads and lists it with filters, updates it, deactivates and activates it (an agreement with an inactive vendor is refused) and reads its audit ledger. Records agreements (contract, warranty, support plan, licence term) with a reference, the days it is in force, the notice and the optional asset, judged on the day they are read as NOT_STARTED, IN_FORCE, EXPIRING or EXPIRED, with the days to the end (nothing of the verdict is stored), lists them by standing, vendor, kind and asset, renews one by moving its last day, pauses and resumes one (a paused agreement is not judged) and reads its ledger. A second folder proves the service is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-VND-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, missing or unknown category, missing executor or tenant, an end before the start, a term over 3660 days, a notice out of range, a reference that is not an identifier, an unknown kind, a malformed date, missing fields), duplicate names and references (409), illegal transitions, tenant isolation, an unknown vendor, unknown filters and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (vndOrganisationId) and computes every date relative to today.
